dialog.title: Make Mythic: {name}
dialog.intro: Mythic monster template for {name} (level {level}). Choose the basic mythic abilities for each level step.
dialog.noSteps: This creature is below level 1: it gains only the mythic trait and Mythic Points.
dialog.appliedNote: {name} has the mythic template (applied at level {level}). Removing it deletes these abilities and the mythic trait if the template added it.
dialog.bestiaryNote: {name} is already mythic (it has the mythic trait from its statistics). The template is only for non-mythic creatures, so nothing will be changed.

summary.resistance: Mythic Resistance {value} against Strikes from non-mythic creatures
summary.skillAny: Mythic Skill (any skill: the NPC lists no skills)

remove.title: Remove Mythic Template: {name}
remove.content: Remove the mythic abilities the template added to {name}?

errors.notNpc: The mythic template is only for NPCs.
errors.bestiary: {name} is already mythic from its statistics; the template was not applied.
errors.failed: Mythic template for {name} failed. See the console for details.
